text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- A spokesman for the ruling Frelimo Party says all three groups in parliament have agreed that Mozambique's first municipal elections, scheduled by the government for December 27, should be postponed until 1998.

- Reconstruction of one of the two war-damaged power lines from the Cahora Bassa hydro-electric dam in central Mozambique to South Africa has been completed and the line is now being inspected before test transmissions begin.

- Mozambique's Central Census Office has started dispatching additional census material to the northern, central, and southern regions, to avoid any shortages that might disrupt the population census that is now in its sixth day.
